name: Dusky Crab Cakes
summary: In Darkshire, Chef Grual makes Dusky Crab Cakes for the hungry Jitters. Jitters finds the local delicacy exquisite.

sections.title: A Questionable Delicacy
sections.body:
Chef Grual makes Dusky Crab Cakes for Jitters, a terrified vagrant whose hunger has overcome him. Duskwood has few fresh provisions, so cooks make do with meat from the forest.

The cakes look like ordinary seafood patties, but Grual uses meat from the legs of Duskwood’s monstrous arachnids. Jitters devours them, unaware of what he is eating.

faq.q: What are Dusky Crab Cakes actually made of?
aliases: what is in dusky crab cakes
faq.answer: Chef Grual keeps his recipe to himself. Its secret ingredient comes to light while supplies are gathered for him in Duskwood.

faq.q: Who eats the Dusky Crab Cakes?
faq.answer: Chef Grual makes the cakes for Jitters, an anxious man sheltering at Raven Hill who complains of a rumbling stomach.

faq.q: How does Jitters react to the cakes?
faq.answer: Starving, Jitters happily devours the cakes without questioning their recipe. He is grateful for a meal that satisfies his hunger.

faq.q: Who cooks the Dusky Crab Cakes?
faq.answer: Chef Grual, cook at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire, prepares the cakes from supplies gathered for him.

angles.text: Grual’s cakes show how a cook can make a tangy local specialty from ingredients found in Duskwood.
